title: Control Plane: API Schema Recon Probe
description: Requests to the interactive docs / OpenAPI schema endpoints (/docs, /redoc, /openapi.json) which are disabled by default (SEC-2). Any 404 burst here indicates reconnaissance enumerating the API surface.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Control Plane Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Control Plane Access Logs') and ('URI Path' = '/docs' or 'URI Path' = '/redoc' or 'URI Path' = '/openapi.json') | stats count as probes by 'Source IP' | where probes > 3
falsepositives: A developer with CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLE_DOCS=true browsing the docs
